title: No Passport, No Entry
description: Even the feature-flag endpoint, open to every logged-in role, still requires someone to be logged in at all. Confirm an anonymous caller is turned away at the door.
successCondition: GET /api/admin/feature-flags with no Authorization header returns 401. GET /api/admin/audit-log and POST /api/admin/shipments/bulk with no Authorization header each also return 401 rather than 403 or 200.
hints: The preHandler authenticate hook runs on every route in this module before the per-route role check.
Don't send an Authorization header at all — an empty string or malformed header is a different (still 401) case, not the same test.
